brandKit.fact1: A brand board is a visual reference that captures your logo, color palette, and typography in one place.
brandKit.fact2: Brand boards keep design teams aligned by providing a single source of truth for visual decisions.
brandKit.fact3: A typical brand board includes logo variations, color codes, and font pairings.
brandKit.fact4: Brand boards prevent visual drift by documenting approved design assets and usage rules.
brandKit.fact5: Typography on a brand board defines heading fonts, body fonts, and how they pair.
brandKit.fact6: Brand boards are shared with agencies, partners, and vendors to maintain consistency.
brandKit.fact7: A well-built brand board makes every campaign, page, and social post feel like the same brand.
